# Images the platform charts render that are deliberately NOT Docker Hardened.
#
# The mirror drift check in .github/workflows/ci.yml fails if a chart renders an
# image that is neither on our DHI mirror nor listed here. That is the check that
# was MISSING when the loki 6.7.1 -> 7.3.0 bump silently introduced
# `docker.io/kiwigrid/k8s-sidecar:2.5.0`: the old check only verified that dhi/*
# refs were mirrored, so a brand-new non-DHI image was invisible to it.
#
# Adding a line here is a deliberate decision, not a formality — say WHY, so the
# next person can tell "no DHI equivalent exists" apart from "nobody looked yet".
#
# Format: one image reference (registry/repo:tag), exactly as rendered.
# Tracking: Blue-Dots-Economy/bluedots-automation#136

# ── Kong ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# DHI publishes the Kong GATEWAY but no kubernetes-ingress-controller. Swapping
# only the gateway while the controller beside it stays upstream buys little and
# splits the pair across two provenance chains, so both stay upstream until the
# controller has an equivalent.
kong:3.9
kong/kubernetes-ingress-controller:3.5

# Redis was here. It is now on the mirror (dhi/redis:7.4.11-compat) — the
# Bitnami chart only needed bash, cp and redis-server from the image, and the
# -compat variant supplies all three.

# ── Postgres ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Our own build (dockerfiles/postgres/), Bitnami base + portable pgvector —
# see that Dockerfile's header for why Bitnami over a DHI postgres (AVX-512
# SIGILL fix). Only rendered with postgresql.enabled=true + the env overlay.
ghcr.io/blue-dots-economy/postgres-pgvector:sha-5d4f334

# postgresBootstrap Job: official upstream image, one-shot pre-install hook
# that never serves traffic. Only rendered with postgresBootstrap.enabled=true
# + an RDS host set.
postgres:17-alpine

# rdsRelay sidecar: official upstream image, needs only psql. Only rendered
# with rdsRelay.enabled=true + an RDS host set. Tracked for pinning (TODO in
# helm/common-services/templates/rds-relay.yaml) — :latest is the actual gap,
# not the absence of a DHI equivalent.
alpine/socat:latest

# ── Cluster Autoscaler ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Official k8s.io image; no DHI equivalent published. Only rendered with
# clusterAutoscaler.enabled=true (default off).
registry.k8s.io/autoscaling/cluster-autoscaler:v1.35.0

# ── Keycloak realm-import scripting sidecars ────────────────────────────────
# Official Alpine; the kc-init Job apk-installs curl/jq/python3 at runtime to
# reconcile the realm over the admin REST API — a one-shot Job, not a service.
alpine:3.20

# ── Signals migrate Job ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Official upstream image; the migrate Job's `provision` sidecar only runs
# psql against Postgres once, then exits.
postgres:16-alpine

# ── prometheus-operator's --thanos-default-base-image flag ──────────────────
# A CLI default for the operator to inject a Thanos sidecar into a Prometheus
# CR that opts in. Nothing in this chart creates a ThanosRuler or sets a
# Thanos config (grep for `ThanosRuler`/`thanos:` in helm/monitoring/ turns up
# nothing), so this default is never actually pulled. Found by broadening the
# unhardened-image check to also scan `--*-image=` flags, not just `image:`
# keys — same blind spot class as cert-manager's acmesolver (mirrored, not
# exempted, since that one genuinely runs on every ACME challenge).
quay.io/thanos/thanos:v0.42.4
